_doc: ORDER-840 G1 stake ladder. Read only by systems/GambleStakeLadder.gd. In a full run the racetrack stakes and the hold'em buy-ins (and blinds) come from the highest tier the run has opened; outside a full run the tables keep their fixed lists. A tier opens at min_turn when any requires_any flag is set (empty = none needed), the run has made min_visits habit visits to that activity (BranchHabit), and cash is at least min_cash. Large tables can bankrupt. The private tier (year 4, after a high-stakes session, cash 1억+) keeps a rare 30억 tail open on purpose (user decision 2026-11-28): one 1억 trifecta or a run of 3억 hold'em pots; most runs lose it in a few hands.
